headline: Supreme Court Rules on Governor's Assent Deadlines Under Article 200
body: The Supreme Court constitution bench reiterated that Governors cannot pocket-veto state legislation indefinitely under Article 200 of the Constitution. The apex court held that constitutional functionaries must exercise statutory assent or refer bills to the President as expeditiously as practicable. Withholding assent without returning the bill to the Legislative Assembly with recommendations violates democratic governance and federal comity. The ruling strengthens cooperative federalism by preventing unelected titular heads from paralyzing elected state legislatures.

body: The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP) presented a policy framework evaluating the structural feasibility of statutory Minimum Support Price (MSP) guarantees based on Swaminathan Committee C2+50 percent recommendations. While paid-out costs and family labor (A2+FL) remain the operational benchmark, the report recommends targeted price deficiency payment mechanisms (PDPS), direct procurement expansion for nutri-cereals (millets), and decentralized warehousing to prevent fiscal strain on the national exchequer.
hindi: कृषि लागत एवं मूल्य आयोग (CACP) ने स्वामीनाथन आयोग की C2+50% सिफारिशों के संदर्भ में न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) और मूल्य न्यूनता भुगतान प्रणाली (PDPS) पर महत्वपूर्ण रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत की।

syllabus: GS-III: Science & Technology, Indigenization & Semiconductor Ecosystem
headline: India Semiconductor Mission Inks Bilateral Tech Transfer for 28nm Fabrication
body: Under the modified 76,000-crore India Semiconductor Mission (ISM), construction commenced on commercial commercial semiconductor fabrication and advanced packaging (ATMP/OSAT) units in Dholera, Gujarat and Morigaon, Assam. Benefiting from 50 percent fiscal capital expenditure support from the Union Government, the facilities will produce microcontrollers, power management integrated circuits, and automotive silicon nodes. This initiative addresses strategic vulnerabilities in critical supply chains, cutting electronic import reliance.
hindi: भारत सेमीकंडक्टर मिशन के तहत गुजरात के धोलेरा और असम में 28nm चिप निर्माण और पैकेजिंग संयंत्रों का निर्माण शुरू हुआ, जिससे इलेक्ट्रॉनिक आयात पर भारत की निर्भरता कम होगी।

syllabus: GS-I: Indian Heritage, Art Forms, Architecture & Fortification Systems
headline: Maratha Military Landscapes Formally Nominated for UNESCO World Heritage Status
body: India's official dossier for the 'Maratha Military Landscapes'—comprising twelve hill and coastal fortresses including Raigad, Shivneri, Sindhudurg, and Pratapgad—was reviewed by ICOMOS for UNESCO World Heritage inscription. Built across the Sahyadri ranges between the 17th and 19th centuries under Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, these forts exemplify indigenous guerrilla warfare engineering, hydraulic stepwells, and natural terrain integration that defied imperial Mughal and naval colonial expansion.
hindi: छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज द्वारा निर्मित रायगढ़, शिवनेरी और सिंधुदुर्ग सहित 12 मराठा किलों को यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल के रूप में नामांकित किया गया। ये मध्यकालीन सैन्य वास्तुकला के उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण हैं।

syllabus: GS-IV: Ethics, Integrity & Aptitude in Public Service Governance
headline: Ethics in Public Administration: 2nd ARC Recommendations on Conflict of Interest
body: The Department of Personnel and Training circulated updated civil service conduct guidelines operationalizing the Second Administrative Reforms Commission (2nd ARC) tenets on institutional conflict of interest. The framework mandates comprehensive annual asset disclosures, cooling-off restrictions for senior bureaucrats transitioning into corporate directorships, and robust statutory protection for whistleblowers under the Central Vigilance Commission. Institutionalizing these ethical guardrails reinforces public trust and constitutional morality in welfare administration.
hindi: द्वितीय प्रशासनिक सुधार आयोग (2nd ARC) की सिफारिशों के तहत सिविल सेवकों के लिए हितों के टकराव, संपत्ति प्रकटीकरण और व्हिसलब्लोअर संरक्षण से संबंधित कड़े नैतिक दिशा-निर्देश जारी किए गए।

syllabus: GS-III: Infrastructure: Energy, Ports, Roads, Railways & Fiscal Federalism
headline: National Infrastructure Pipeline Crosses 150 Lakh Crore Milestone with State Capex Loans
body: The Union Ministry of Finance reported that capital expenditure disbursements under the Scheme for Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment crossed record thresholds. Channeled through 50-year interest-free loans, state governments deployed capital into PM Gati Shakti multi-modal logistics hubs, optical fiber connectivity for village secretariats, and industrial park modernization. High-multiplier public capital investment crowds in private corporate investments while sustaining national GDP growth above seven percent.
hindi: केंद्र सरकार ने राज्यों को 50-वर्षीय ब्याज मुक्त ऋण के माध्यम से रिकॉर्ड पूंजीगत व्यय (Capex) प्रदान किया, जिससे पीएम गति शक्ति और बहु-मॉडल रसद अवसंरचना में व्यापक विस्तार हुआ है।

syllabus: GS-III: Biodiversity, Endangered Species, In-situ Conservation & National Parks
headline: Project Cheetah Expansion: New Release Enclosures Operationalized at Gandhi Sagar
body: The National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) completed predator-proof bomas and prey augmentation at the Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary in Madhya Pradesh to establish a second viable wild population of Asiatic and African cheetahs. Following acclimatization at Kuno National Park, spatial dispersion across the Chambal river basin mitigates epidemic risks, avoids inter-clan territorial clashes, and restores semi-arid open savanna grassland biodiversity, a historically neglected habitat under Indian forestry.
hindi: कूनो राष्ट्रीय उद्यान के बाद मध्य प्रदेश के गांधी सागर अभयारण्य में चीता पुनर्वास परियोजना का दूसरा चरण शुरू किया गया, जिससे घास के मैदानों और जैव विविधता का संरक्षण होगा।

syllabus: GS-II: Parliament and State Legislatures, Elections & Federal Balance
headline: Delimitation Commission Preparatory Baseline: Balancing Federalism and Population Parity
body: Constitutional scholars and parliamentary committees convened to review the prospective post-census delimitation of Lok Sabha constituencies. While Article 82 mandates readjustment of seats following decennial census exercises, southern states that rigorously implemented national family welfare and population stabilization policies voiced concerns over prospective representation dilution. Policy proposals suggest weightage adjustments, expansion of Rajya Sabha federal prerogatives, or capping regional seat shares to harmonize democratic representation with cooperative federal stability.
hindi: आगामी परिसीमन आयोग के संदर्भ में जनसंख्या और संघीय प्रतिनिधित्व के बीच संतुलन बनाने पर राष्ट्रीय बहस शुरू हुई, ताकि जनसंख्या नियंत्रण करने वाले राज्यों का प्रतिनिधित्व कम न हो।

syllabus: GS-III: Indigenization of Technology, Defense & Strategic Deterrence
headline: DRDO Successfully Flight-Tests Long-Range Hypersonic Glide Vehicle
body: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) executed a successful maiden flight test of its indigenous Long-Range Hypersonic Glide Missile from Dr APJ Abdul Kalam Island off the Odisha coast. Capable of carrying conventional and strategic payloads over distances exceeding 1,500 kilometers, the vehicle demonstrated sustained aerodynamic maneuverability at speeds exceeding Mach 6 in the upper atmosphere, neutralizing conventional missile defense shields and reinforcing second-strike credible deterrence.
hindi: डीआरडीओ ने ओडिशा तट से स्वदेशी हाइपरसोनिक ग्लाइड मिसाइल का सफल परीक्षण किया। मैक 6 से अधिक की गति और 1500 किमी से अधिक मारक क्षमता भारत की सामरिक रक्षा को अभेद्य बनाती है।

syllabus: GS-II: Issues Relating to Development and Management of Social Sector/Services: Health
headline: Universal Health Coverage: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Expanded to All Seniors Aged 70+
body: The Union Cabinet approved the universal expansion of the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY) to provide five lakh rupees annual cashless secondary and tertiary hospital coverage to all senior citizens aged 70 and above, regardless of household income or socioeconomic status. Operationalized through distinct golden health cards integrated with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), the reform mitigates catastrophic out-of-pocket geriatric healthcare expenditures.
hindi: केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल ने 70 वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु के सभी वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को आय सीमा के बिना आयुष्मान भारत (PM-JAY) के तहत 5 लाख रुपये का वार्षिक निःशुल्क स्वास्थ्य बीमा प्रदान करने की मंजूरी दी।

syllabus: GS-III: Infrastructure: Energy & Renewable Green Transition Initiatives
headline: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana Crosses One Crore Registrations in Rooftop Solar Drive
body: With a 75,021-crore outlay, the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana achieved unprecedented public adoption, providing direct bank transfer subsidies up to 78,000 rupees for residential rooftop solar photovoltaic installations. Discoms are integrated through digital national portals to expedite net-metering approvals and smart bi-directional meters. Generating up to 300 units of free monthly electricity per household, the scheme reduces commercial discom distribution losses while decentralizing renewable generation toward India's 500 GW non-fossil fuel capacity goal.
hindi: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना के तहत 1 करोड़ से अधिक परिवारों ने पंजीकरण कराया। यह योजना 300 यूनिट मुफ्त बिजली और सब्सिडी प्रदान कर भारत के हरित ऊर्जा लक्ष्यों को गति दे रही है।

syllabus: GS-II: Important International Institutions, Agencies & Fora
headline: Voice of Global South Summit Solidifies South-South Development Compact
body: Chairing the virtual Voice of Global South Summit, India unveiled the 'Global South Development Compact' focusing on digital public infrastructure (DPI) technology sharing, sustainable debt restructuring, and capacity building in affordable healthcare. Over 120 participating developing nations endorsed reformed multilateralism, calling for immediate expansion of the UN Security Council permanent membership and equitable SDR quotas at the IMF to overcome weaponized financial hierarchies.
hindi: भारत की अध्यक्षता में आयोजित वॉयस ऑफ ग्लोबल साउथ समिट में डिजिटल पब्लिक इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर और सतत ऋण समाधान के लिए 'ग्लोबल साउथ डेवलपमेंट कॉम्पैक्ट' को सर्वसम्मति से स्वीकार किया गया।

syllabus: GS-III: Disaster and Disaster Management: Urban Planning & Drainage Resilience
headline: NDMA Formulates Sponge Cities Blueprint to Counter Unprecedented Urban Floods
body: In response to recurrent inundations in metropolitan centers like Chennai, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) issued the National Urban Flood Mitigation Guidelines. Central to the framework is the conversion of municipal concretized zones into 'Sponge Cities' utilizing permeable pavements, natural swales, rejuvenation of inter-connected stepwells, and strict prohibition of construction on river floodplains. Municipal master plans must integrate climate risk modeling to protect urban economic lifelines.
hindi: एनडीएमए (NDMA) ने शहरों में भीषण जलभराव से निपटने के लिए 'स्पंज सिटी' दिशानिर्देश जारी किए, जिसमें पारगम्य फुटपाथ, जल निकायों के पुनरुद्धार और बाढ़ मैदानों के संरक्षण पर बल दिया गया है।

syllabus: GS-II: Parliament & State Legislatures: Powers, Privileges & Tenth Schedule
headline: Law Commission Recommends Speaker Disqualification Powers Transfer to Election Commission
body: The Law Commission of India submitted consultation recommendations urging structural amendments to the Tenth Schedule (Anti-Defection Law). Citing systemic delays and partisan bias in adjudicating MLA/MP defection petitions by presiding officers, the report suggested transferring final disqualification authority to the President or Governor acting on the binding advice of the Election Commission of India, mirroring the constitutional procedure established under Article 103 and Article 192.
hindi: विधि आयोग ने 10वीं अनुसूची (दल-बदल विरोधी कानून) में संशोधन की सिफारिश की, जिसके तहत विधायकों की अयोग्यता का निर्णय स्पीकर के स्थान पर चुनाव आयोग की बाध्यकारी सलाह पर करने का सुझाव दिया गया।

syllabus: GS-III: Issues Related to Direct and Indirect Farm Subsidies & Soil Health
headline: PM-PRANAM and Gobardhan Fuel Shift Toward Bio-Fertilizers and Soil Rejuvenation
body: The Union Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers released performance metrics for the PM Programme for Restoration, Awareness, Nourishment and Amelioration of Mother Earth (PM-PRANAM). The program incentivizes state governments to substitute chemical urea with fermented organic manure and nano-DAP, utilizing 50 percent of saved chemical fertilizer subsidy budgets for local agrarian capital grants. Concurrently, Gobardhan compressed biogas (CBG) plants are integrated into rural livestock clusters, converting agricultural stubble into clean energy.
hindi: पीएम-प्रणाम योजना के माध्यम से रासायनिक उर्वरकों पर निर्भरता कम करके जैविक खाद और नैनो-डीएपी को बढ़ावा दिया जा रहा है, जिससे मिट्टी की उर्वरता और किसानों की आय में वृद्धि होगी।

syllabus: GS-II: Election Commission & Electoral Reforms
headline: ECI Enforces Model Code of Conduct Across Social Media and Generative AI
body: The Election Commission of India notified binding directives regulating deepfake audio-visual synthesis and algorithmic surrogate campaigning during state assembly elections. Platforms are mandated to label synthetic media, remove unlawful content within three hours under IT Rules, and declare political advertising expenditures transparently.
hindi: चुनाव आयोग ने चुनावों में डीपफेक और एआई जनित भ्रामक प्रचार पर रोक लगाने के लिए सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म्स पर कड़े नियम लागू किए।

syllabus: GS-II: Federal Relations & Inter-State Water Dispute Adjudication
headline: Inter-State River Water Disputes: Supreme Court on Article 262 Tribunal Reforms
body: The Supreme Court advocated for a single permanent tribunal with multiple benches to eliminate decades-long delays in Cauvery, Krishna, and Godavari disputes. Establishing a robust River Basin Management Authority with real-time telemetry data curtails inter-state politicization of natural riparian flows.
hindi: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने अंतर-राज्यीय जल विवादों के त्वरित समाधान के लिए एक स्थायी ट्रिब्यूनल और वास्तविक समय के डेटा तंत्र की आवश्यकता पर बल दिया।

syllabus: GS-II: Dispute Redressal Mechanisms & Access to Justice for Marginalized
headline: Gram Nyayalayas Implementation: Bridging Rural Access to Justice Under 2008 Act
body: A parliamentary standing committee raised concerns over low operationalization of mobile village courts by state governments. Providing doorstep civil and summary criminal trial access directly empowers rural women and agrarian laborers while decongesting subordinate judicial dockets.
hindi: संसदीय समिति ने ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में त्वरित और सस्ते न्याय के लिए ग्राम न्यायालयों की संख्या बढ़ाने और उन्हें पर्याप्त बजटीय सहायता देने का निर्देश दिया।

syllabus: GS-II: Statutory Bodies for Protection of Vulnerable Sections
headline: National Commission for Scheduled Tribes Issues Directives on Forest Rights Verification
body: The NCST intervened to ensure Gram Sabhas hold decisive statutory authority when evaluating community forest resource rights under the FRA 2006. Rejection of claims without speaking orders by District Level Committees violates constitutional protections enshrined under Schedule V.
hindi: राष्ट्रीय अनुसूचित जनजाति आयोग ने वन अधिकार अधिनियम के तहत ग्राम सभाओं के अधिकारों की रक्षा और दावों के पारदर्शी सत्यापन के निर्देश दिए।

syllabus: GS-II: Statutory Bodies, Federal Investigating Agencies & Rule of Law
headline: CBI General Consent: Constitutional Dynamics of Section 6 of DSPE Act
body: Constitutional benches examined the legal consequences of states withdrawing general consent under the Delhi Special Police Establishment Act. While state autonomy over police is preserved under List II, central anti-corruption enforcement cannot be frustrated where inter-state commercial ramifications emerge.
hindi: उच्चतम न्यायालय ने सीबीआई को दी जाने वाली आम सहमति (General Consent) वापस लेने के राज्यों के अधिकार और केंद्रीय जांच शक्तियों के बीच संवैधानिक संतुलन का परीक्षण किया।

syllabus: GS-III: Effects of Liberalization, Corporate Insolvency & Ease of Doing Business
headline: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) Pre-Pack Framework Expanded for Mid-Sized Corporates
body: The Ministry of Corporate Affairs amended the IBC to enable pre-packaged insolvency resolution processes for medium enterprises. Preserving existing operational management while restructuring stressed balance sheets curtails corporate asset erosion and expedites financial creditor recoveries.
hindi: कॉरपोरेट मामलों के मंत्रालय ने मध्यम उद्यमों के लिए दिवाला संहिता (IBC) के प्री-पैक ढांचे का विस्तार किया, जिससे कंपनियों के परिसमापन को रोका जा सकेगा।

syllabus: GS-III: Infrastructure: Logistics, Transport & Competitiveness
headline: National Logistics Policy: Reducing Freight Costs to Sub-8 Percent of National GDP
body: India's logistics sector witnessed unified coordination via the Unified Logistics Interface Platform (ULIP). Integrating digital manifests across customs, port terminals, and dedicated freight corridors reduces container turnaround times and elevates export competitiveness in international markets.
hindi: राष्ट्रीय लॉजिस्टिक्स नीति के तहत डिजिटल एकीकरण और डेडिकेटेड फ्रेट कॉरिडोर से रसद लागत को सकल घरेलू उत्पाद के 8% से नीचे लाने का लक्ष्य रखा गया है।

syllabus: GS-III: Government Budgeting, Green Finance & Public Debt Management
headline: Sovereign Green Bonds: RBI Allocates Capital Receipts Toward Clean Grid Expansion
body: The Reserve Bank concluded tranches of Sovereign Green Bonds dedicated exclusively to non-fossil public investments. Proceeds are allocated to grid-scale battery storage, pumped hydro projects, and electrification of public transport fleets under transparent green taxonomy rules.
hindi: आरबीआई ने सॉवरेन ग्रीन बॉन्ड जारी कर स्वच्छ ऊर्जा, बैटरी भंडारण और सार्वजनिक परिवहन के विद्युतीकरण के लिए हरित पूंजी जुटाई।

syllabus: GS-III: Mineral Security, Industrial Policy & Self-Reliance
headline: Critical and Strategic Minerals Auction: Securing Lithium, Cobalt and Rare Earths
body: The Ministry of Mines concluded auctions for offshore and onshore critical mineral blocks across Jammu & Kashmir, Chhattisgarh, and Karnataka. Domestic processing of lithium and nickel directly feeds indigenous gigafactory battery production, insulating the economy from geopolitical embargoes.
hindi: खान मंत्रालय ने लिथियम और दुर्लभ खनिज ब्लॉकों की नीलामी पूरी की, जो इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों और उच्च तकनीक विनिर्माण के लिए अत्यंत आवश्यक हैं।

syllabus: GS-III: Direct and Indirect Farm Subsidies, PDS & Fiscal Prudence
headline: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Overhauls Fertilizer Subsidy via Aadhaar Verification
body: Real-time point-of-sale biometric authentication curbed diversion of subsidized agricultural urea to industrial units. Eliminating ghost beneficiaries saves thousands of crores annually, creating fiscal bandwidth for precision nutrient-based subsidy (NBS) enhancements.
hindi: उर्वरक सब्सिडी में आधार प्रमाणीकरण और प्रत्यक्ष लाभ अंतरण (DBT) लागू होने से कालाबाजारी रुकी और वास्तविक किसानों को सीधा लाभ मिला।

syllabus: GS-III: Science and Technology: Quantum Computing & Communication
headline: National Quantum Mission: Indian Consortia Develop Superconducting Qubit Processors
body: The National Quantum Mission funded premier academic and research laboratories to fabricate indigenous 20-50 qubit processors. Concurrently, quantum key distribution (QKD) over satellite-to-ground fiber links was validated, safeguarding national defense communication from post-quantum decryption.
hindi: राष्ट्रीय क्वांटम मिशन के तहत भारतीय वैज्ञानिकों ने स्वदेशी 20-50 क्यूबिट प्रोसेसर और अत्यधिक सुरक्षित क्वांटम संचार नेटवर्क विकसित करने में सफलता पाई।

syllabus: GS-III: Deep Ocean Mining, Marine Resources & Oceanography
headline: Deep Ocean Mission: Matsya 6000 Submersible Completes Deepwater Manned Trials
body: The Ministry of Earth Sciences conducted deep-sea pressure hull tests for the indigenous submersible Matsya 6000. Capable of carrying scientists to depths of 6,000 meters in the Central Indian Ocean, the mission investigates polymetallic nodules containing copper, cobalt, and hydrothermal vents.
hindi: गहरे समुद्र मिशन के तहत स्वदेशी 'मत्स्य 6000' पनडुब्बी का सफल परीक्षण किया गया, जो हिंद महासागर में 6000 मीटर नीचे दुर्लभ खनिजों की खोज करेगी।

syllabus: GS-III: Biotechnology, Genomics, Precision Medicine & Bioinformatics
headline: Genome India Project Delivers Reference Catalog of 10,000 Indian Genomes
body: The Department of Biotechnology mapped the comprehensive genetic diversity of over 10,000 diverse Indian ethnic cohorts. The open reference bio-repository accelerates personalized therapies for rare inherited ailments and targeted crop genetic engineering for drought-resilient agriculture.
hindi: जीनोम इंडिया प्रोजेक्ट ने 10,000 भारतीयों के जीनोम अनुक्रमण का संदर्भ डेटाबेस पूरा किया, जिससे सटीक दवाएं और दुर्लभ बीमारियों का इलाज संभव होगा।

syllabus: GS-III: Computers, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics & Ethics
headline: Artificial Intelligence Regulatory Framework: NITI Aayog Proposes Risk-Tiered Governance
body: Balancing technological innovation with algorithmic accountability, NITI Aayog outlined a risk-based governance architecture for artificial intelligence. Critical systems in healthcare, policing, and welfare allocation require algorithmic audits, explainability standards, and bias testing.
hindi: नीति आयोग ने एआई के नैतिक उपयोग और सुरक्षा के लिए जोखिम-आधारित नियामक ढांचा तैयार किया, जिसमें ऑडिट और पूर्वाग्रह निवारण अनिवार्य होगा।

syllabus: GS-III: Space Industry Commercialization & IN-SPACe
headline: Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV) Indigenization Transferred to Private Industry
body: IN-SPACe oversaw the formal commercial technology transfer of the SSLV rocket to private Indian industrial consortia. Offering rapid turnaround times and low manufacturing overheads, the rocket positions India as a premier destination for global low-earth-orbit constellation deployments.
hindi: इन-स्पेस ने छोटे उपग्रह प्रक्षेपण यान (SSLV) की तकनीक को निजी उद्योग को स्थानांतरित किया, जिससे वैश्विक अंतरिक्ष बाजार में भारत की हिस्सेदारी बढ़ेगी।

syllabus: GS-III: Environmental Impact Assessment, Coastal Regulation & Island Ecology
headline: Great Nicobar Transshipment and Defense Project: Ecological Mitigation Protocol
body: The Ministry of Environment outlined compensatory conservation measures for the Galathea Bay container hub on Great Nicobar Island. Designated zones for the protection of giant leatherback sea turtles and Nicobar megapodes are paired with multi-tiered mangrove replanting programs.
hindi: ग्रेट निकोबार विकास परियोजना के तहत समुद्री कछुओं और दुर्लभ पक्षियों के संरक्षण के लिए कड़े पर्यावरण संरक्षण उपाय अधिसूचित किए गए।

syllabus: GS-III: Environmental Conservation, Gadgil vs Kasturirangan Reports
headline: Western Ghats Ecologically Sensitive Areas (ESA) Notification Review
body: State governments and the Union Environment Ministry re-evaluated the spatial demarcation of 56,800 square kilometers of Western Ghats ESAs. Balancing landslide risk prevention with agrarian township livelihood preservation remains the core friction point across Kerala, Karnataka, and Maharashtra.
hindi: पश्चिमी घाट में पर्यावरण संवेदनशील क्षेत्रों (ESA) के निर्धारण पर समीक्षा बैठक हुई, जिसमें भूस्खलन रोकथाम और स्थानीय आजीविका का संतुलन अहम मुद्दा है।

syllabus: GS-III: Wetlands Conservation, Ramsar Sites & Migratory Avifauna
headline: Ramsar Convention: India Designates Five Additional High-Altitude Himalayan Wetlands
body: India expanded its internationally recognized Ramsar wetland network to over 85 sites, incorporating pristine glacial and lacustrine ecosystems in Ladakh and Himachal Pradesh. These wetland sanctuaries provide critical staging grounds along the Central Asian Flyway for endangered migratory birds.
hindi: भारत ने लद्दाख और हिमाचल प्रदेश के 5 उच्च-ऊंचाई वाले आर्द्रभूमियों को रामसर स्थलों में शामिल किया, जिससे प्रवासी पक्षियों के आवास सुरक्षित होंगे।

syllabus: GS-III: Environmental Pollution, Air Quality & Public Health
headline: Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) Enforces Stricter GRAP Norms in NCR
body: CAQM mandated automated remote-sensing emissions monitoring and synchronized mechanical sweeping across the National Capital Region. Stubble ex-situ management through bio-pellet co-firing in thermal plants reduced seasonal farm fire contribution to peak winter PM2.5 levels.
hindi: वायु गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन आयोग (CAQM) ने दिल्ली-एनसीआर में प्रदूषण नियंत्रण के लिए ग्रेडेड रिस्पांस एक्शन प्लान (GRAP) के कड़े नियम लागू किए।

syllabus: GS-III: Urban Forestry, Climate Adaptation & Carbon Sequestration
headline: Miyawaki Urban Forests: Expanding Micro-Green Belts in Densely Populated Metros
body: Municipal corporations across Hyderabad, Delhi, and Ahmedabad deployed the Japanese Miyawaki planting method to restore biodiversity on vacant urban plots. Growing 10 times faster with 30 times greater carbon sequestration density, these mini forests counteract urban heat island effects.
hindi: मियावाकी पद्धति से शहरों में घने शहरी वनों का निर्माण किया जा रहा है, जिससे तापमान नियंत्रण और जैव विविधता में व्यापक सुधार हुआ है।

syllabus: GS-I: Ancient Indian History, Harappan Civilization & Urban Planning
headline: Dholavira Ancient Water Management System: Engineering Lessons for Modern Droughts
body: Archaeological surveys highlighted the sophisticated stormwater reservoirs and check-dams constructed at the Harappan metropolis of Dholavira in Kutch. Adapting these three-thousand-year-old rock-cut cascading cistern techniques offers sustainable drought mitigation models for modern arid topography.
hindi: कच्छ में हड़प्पा कालीन धोलावीरा की प्राचीन जल संचयन प्रणाली आधुनिक सूखा प्रबंधन और जल संरक्षण के लिए एक अद्वितीय ऐतिहासिक उदाहरण प्रस्तुत करती है।

syllabus: GS-I: Urban Geography, Climate Vulnerability & Building Architecture
headline: Urban Heat Island (UHI) Mitigation: Cool Roof Policies Adopted Across Deccan Cities
body: State urban development departments mandated solar-reflective white coatings and vegetative green roofs on commercial and low-income residential buildings. High-albedo reflective coatings drop interior ambient temperatures by 3-5 degrees Celsius, reducing heatstroke mortality and energy peak demand.
hindi: दक्कन के प्रमुख शहरों में शहरी ताप द्वीप प्रभाव से निपटने के लिए 'कूल रूफ' नीतियां लागू की गईं, जिससे भवनों का तापमान 5 डिग्री तक कम होता है।

syllabus: GS-I: Physical Geography: Glacial Geomorphology & Himalayan Hazards
headline: Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOF): Early Warning Sensor Networks in Sikkim and Uttarakhand
body: The Geological Survey of India installed real-time automated water level radar and satellite telemetry at vulnerable high-altitude moraine-dammed glacial lakes. Early warning sirens allow downstream mountain settlements crucial evacuation windows during sudden breach occurrences triggered by seismic tremors.
hindi: सिक्किम और उत्तराखंड में हिमनद झील विस्फोट से उत्पन्न बाढ़ (GLOF) की पूर्व चेतावनी के लिए उपग्रह आधारित सेंसर नेटवर्क स्थापित किए गए।

syllabus: GS-I: Population and Associated Issues, Urbanization & Internal Migration
headline: Demographic Dividend: Regional Fertility Divergence and Internal Labor Migration
body: Demographic analyses revealed striking variance across Indian states: southern and western states have dipped below the 1.8 Total Fertility Rate (TFR), while northern states maintain young demographics. Ensuring portable social security and cross-state labor rights prevents structural industrial shortages.
hindi: भारत में राज्यों के बीच जनसांख्यिकीय बदलाव और आंतरिक श्रम प्रवासन पर रिपोर्ट: सामाजिक सुरक्षा की पोर्टेबिलिटी सुनिश्चित करना आर्थिक विकास के लिए आवश्यक है।

syllabus: GS-I: Role of Women and Women's Organizations, Social Empowerment
headline: Care Economy and Unpaid Domestic Labor: Measuring Women's True GDP Contributions
body: The Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation published Time Use Survey data analyzing gender disparity in unpaid domestic care activities. Institutionalizing state-subsidized creches, piped clean fuel, and elderly daycare centers frees female labor capacity for formalized workforce participation.
hindi: सांख्यिकी मंत्रालय के टाइम यूज़ सर्वे में महिलाओं के अवैतनिक घरेलू श्रम को मान्यता देने और देखभाल अर्थव्यवस्था को सुदृढ़ करने पर बल दिया गया।

syllabus: GS-II: Effect of Policies and Politics of Developed & Developing Countries
headline: Chabahar Port: India Inks 10-Year Long-Term Contract with Iran for Shahid Beheshti Terminal
body: India Ports Global Limited signed a milestone ten-year agreement to operate the strategic Shahid Beheshti terminal at Chabahar Port. Circumventing land transit barriers, the multimodal trade route connects western Indian maritime hubs with Afghanistan and Central Asian nations under INSTC corridors.
hindi: भारत ने ईरान के चाबहार बंदरगाह के संचालन के लिए 10-वर्षीय दीर्घकालिक समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर किए, जिससे मध्य एशिया तक व्यापारिक पहुंच सुगम होगी।

syllabus: GS-II: Regional Groupings, Maritime Security & Neighborhood First
headline: BIMSTEC Charter Enters into Legal Force: Transforming Bay of Bengal Regionalism
body: The formal ratification of the BIMSTEC Charter established legal personality for the Bay of Bengal grouping, paving the way for joint coastal maritime transport and free trade agreements. Linking South Asia with Southeast Asia restores historical Bay of Bengal trade vibrancy.
hindi: बिम्सटेक (BIMSTEC) चार्टर के कानूनी रूप से लागू होने से बंगाल की खाड़ी के देशों के बीच समुद्री सुरक्षा, व्यापार और कनेक्टिविटी को नई गति मिली।

syllabus: GS-II: Important International Institutions, Dispute Settlement Mechanism
headline: WTO Appellate Body Crisis: India Advocates for Two-Tier Binding Dispute Settlement
body: At Geneva trade discussions, India opposed interim non-binding arbitration platforms, demanding the immediate restoration of the WTO Appellate Body paralyzed by judicial appointment blockades. An enforceable dispute settlement arm protects emerging economies from unilateral protectionist tariff impositions.
hindi: भारत ने विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO) में दो-स्तरीय बाध्यकारी विवाद निपटान प्रणाली को तुरंत बहाल करने की मांग की, ताकि विकासशील देशों के व्यापारिक हितों की रक्षा हो सके।

syllabus: GS-II & GS-III: International Alliances for Green Transition & Energy Security
headline: Global Biofuels Alliance: India, US and Brazil Standardize Ethanol Blending Mandates
body: Founding members of the Global Biofuels Alliance established unified international standards for biofuels certification, logistics handling, and flex-fuel engine compatibility. The pact drives global clean ethanol demand while unlocking new revenue streams for sugarcane and corn cultivating agrarian communities.
hindi: वैश्विक जैव ईंधन गठबंधन (GBA) के तहत भारत, अमेरिका और ब्राजील ने स्वच्छ ऊर्जा और किसानों की आय बढ़ाने के लिए इथेनॉल सम्मिश्रण मानकों को तय किया।

syllabus: GS-II: Bilateral and Regional Trade Treaties Involving India
headline: India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA) Pledges $100 Billion Investment
body: India finalized the Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement with the European Free Trade Association (Switzerland, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein). Unprecedented in modern trade treaties, the pact binds the EFTA economies to invest 100 billion dollars in Indian manufacturing sectors over 15 years.
hindi: भारत और EFTA देशों के बीच व्यापार और आर्थिक साझेदारी समझौता (TEPA) संपन्न हुआ, जिसके तहत भारत में 100 बिलियन डॉलर का प्रत्यक्ष निवेश आएगा।

syllabus: GS-III: Renewable Energy & Industrial Decarbonization
headline: National Green Hydrogen Mission: SIGHT Program Awards Electrolyser Tenders
body: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy allocated capital subsidies under the Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT) scheme. Domestic consortia won competitive bids to manufacture advanced PEM and alkaline electrolysers, targeting five million metric tonnes of annual green hydrogen production by 2030.
hindi: राष्ट्रीय हरित हाइड्रोजन मिशन के तहत घरेलू इलेक्ट्रोलाइज़र निर्माण के लिए निविदाएं जारी की गईं, जिससे औद्योगिक कार्बन उत्सर्जन में भारी कमी आएगी।

syllabus: GS-III: Forest Conservation, National Security & Ecology
headline: Forest Conservation Amendment Act: Border Exemption Rules Clarified by Supreme Court
body: The Supreme Court clarified provisions of the Forest Conservation Amendment Act, ruling that strategic national defense infrastructure within 100 kilometers of International Borders must still comply with rigorous compensatory afforestation norms and environmental baseline audits.
hindi: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने स्पष्ट किया कि 100 किमी सीमावर्ती रक्षा परियोजनाओं के लिए वन संरक्षण छूट के बावजूद अनिवार्य प्रतिपूरक वनीकरण के नियम लागू रहेंगे।

syllabus: GS-III: Water Pollution, River Rejuvenation & Urban Sanitation
headline: Namami Gange Mission-II: Real-Time Sewage Treatment Telemetry Across Ganga Basin
body: The National Mission for Clean Ganga installed real-time biological oxygen demand (BOD) monitors across all hybrid annuity mode STPs in Kanpur, Prayagraj, and Varanasi. Reclaiming industrial wastewater and rejuvenating tributary channels has restored natural dolphin habitats in the main river stem.
hindi: नमामि गंगे मिशन-2 के तहत वास्तविक समय की सीवेज निगरानी प्रणाली से गंगा नदी के प्रदूषण स्तर में उल्लेखनीय सुधार हुआ और डॉल्फिन की संख्या बढ़ी।

syllabus: GS-II: Social Justice, Reservation Policies & Affirmative Action
headline: Supreme Court Clarifies Sub-Classification of Scheduled Castes Under Article 341
body: A seven-judge constitution bench affirmed that states possess constitutional competence under Article 341 to sub-classify Scheduled Castes to provide affirmative action benefits to historically neglected subgroups, provided empirical data confirms backwardness and non-creamy layer criteria are adhered to.
hindi: उच्चतम न्यायालय की 7-न्यायाधीशों की पीठ ने फैसला दिया कि राज्य अनुसूचित जातियों (SC) के भीतर अधिक वंचित समूहों के लिए उप-वर्गीकरण कर सकते हैं।

syllabus: GS-III: Environmental Ethics, Sustainable Consumption & Waste Reduction
headline: Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment): Global Adoption Metrics at G20
body: India's Mission LiFE framework was integrated into multilateral environmental agendas, promoting individual behavioral modifications to conserve potable water, minimize single-use plastics, and optimize household electricity usage against circular economy benchmarks.
hindi: मिशन लाइफ (LiFE) के तहत पर्यावरण-अनुकूल व्यक्तिगत जीवनशैली और चक्रीय अर्थव्यवस्था को वैश्विक स्तर पर बढ़ावा दिया जा रहा है।

syllabus: GS-II & GS-III: Public Financial Management & Civil Service Welfare
headline: Unified Pension Scheme (UPS): Balancing Fiscal Prudence and Employee Welfare
body: The Union Government operationalized the Unified Pension Scheme, providing government employees guaranteed pensions equal to 50 percent of the last twelve months' average basic salary alongside family pension and inflation indexation, while maintaining a contributory corpus.
hindi: केंद्र सरकार ने एकीकृत पेंशन योजना (UPS) की घोषणा की, जो 50% सुनिश्चित पेंशन और मुद्रास्फीति समायोजन के साथ वित्तीय संतुलन बनाए रखती है।

syllabus: GS-II: Criminal Justice System Reforms, Police & Judiciary
headline: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) Replaces Indian Penal Code: Key Procedural Shifts
body: The enforcement of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam modernized India's colonial-era criminal justice framework. Major enhancements include mandatory forensic videography during searches, community service penalties for minor offenses, and formal recognition of electronic evidence.
hindi: भारतीय न्याय संहिता और नए आपराधिक कानूनों के लागू होने से फॉरेंसिक जांच, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक साक्ष्य और नागरिक अधिकारों को कानूनी मान्यता मिली।

syllabus: GS-II: Welfare Schemes for Vulnerable Sections & Urban Planning
headline: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY-U 2.0): Affordable Green Urban Housing for Middle Class
body: The Union Cabinet sanctioned PMAY-Urban 2.0 with a budgetary outlay exceeding two lakh crore rupees. Channeled via interest subvention subsidies and technology innovation challenges, the initiative constructs energy-efficient, earthquake-resilient homes for urban poor and lower-middle-income demographics.
hindi: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना (शहरी 2.0) के तहत मध्यम वर्ग और शहरी गरीबों के लिए ब्याज सब्सिडी के साथ 1 करोड़ किफायती और हरित घरों का निर्माण होगा।

syllabus: GS-III: Indigenization of Defense Tech & Strategic Command Architecture
headline: Agni-V with MIRV Technology: Strategic Landmark in India's Nuclear Deterrence
body: DRDO's flight test of Mission Divyastra integrated indigenous Multiple Independently Targetable Re-entry Vehicle (MIRV) technology onto the Agni-V intercontinental ballistic missile. A single missile can now disperse multiple warheads across disparate geographic coordinates, reinforcing credible minimum deterrence.
hindi: मिशन दिव्यास्त्र के तहत डीआरडीओ ने अग्नि-5 मिसाइल में MIRV तकनीक का सफल परीक्षण किया, जो एक साथ कई लक्ष्यों को भेदने में सक्षम है।

syllabus: GS-II: Health, Drinking Water Access & Rural Infrastructure
headline: Jal Jeevan Mission Crosses 80 Percent Rural Tap Water Coverage
body: Har Ghar Jal certifications reached rural households across over two lakh villages. Providing 55 liters of potable drinking water per capita per day via automated distribution sensors has dramatically lowered child mortality from water-borne gastroenterological diseases.
hindi: जल जीवन मिशन के तहत 80% से अधिक ग्रामीण परिवारों को नल से स्वच्छ जल उपलब्ध कराया गया, जिससे जलजनित बीमारियों में भारी गिरावट आई है।

syllabus: GS-III: Indian Economy & Fiscal Policy
headline: Direct Tax Collections Exceed Budget Estimates Driven by Corporate Compliance
body: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) reported net direct tax collections surpassed annual budgetary projections, driven by pre-filled AIS forms and faceless assessments. The tax-to-GDP ratio reached historic highs, creating fiscal space for social welfare and infrastructure development.
hindi: सीबीडीटी ने बताया कि प्रत्यक्ष कर संग्रह बजट अनुमानों से अधिक रहा, जिससे भारत का कर-जीडीपी अनुपात सुधरा और राजकोषीय स्थिति मजबूत हुई।

syllabus: GS-II: Welfare Schemes for Vulnerable Sections
headline: PM Vishwakarma Scheme Empowers Traditional Artisans with Collateral-Free Loans
body: The Ministry of MSME disbursed digital skill stipends and subsidized credit up to three lakh rupees to traditional craftspeople across eighteen trades. Integrating digital transactions and quality toolkits preserves ancient indigenous crafts while integrating artisans into modern supply chains.
hindi: पीएम विश्वकर्मा योजना के तहत पारंपरिक शिल्पकारों और कारीगरों को बिना गारंटी के सस्ता ऋण और आधुनिक प्रशिक्षण प्रदान किया जा रहा है।

syllabus: GS-III: Environmental Pollution & Air Quality
headline: National Clean Air Programme (NCAP): Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan Rankings Announced
body: The Ministry of Environment ranked non-attainment cities on ambient particulate reduction metrics. Indore, Agra, and Thane secured top positions for implementing paved road shoulders, green corridors, and continuous ambient air monitoring telemetry.
hindi: स्वच्छ वायु सर्वेक्षण में इंदौर, आगरा और ठाणे शीर्ष पर रहे। एनसीएपी के तहत शहरों में धूल नियंत्रण और वायु गुणवत्ता सुधार पर जोर दिया गया।

syllabus: GS-II: Devolution of Powers and Finances up to Local Levels (PESA)
headline: Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act: Rules Notified Across Central Tribal Belts
body: State governments notified comprehensive PESA rules conferring statutory autonomy to Gram Sabhas over minor forest produce, water bodies, and minor mineral leases. Community consent is mandatory before land alienation, safeguarding indigenous tribal self-rule.
hindi: पेसा (PESA) अधिनियम के नए नियमों से ग्राम सभाओं को लघु वनोपज, जल निकायों और भूमि अधिग्रहण पर पूर्ण वैधानिक नियंत्रण प्राप्त हुआ।

syllabus: GS-III: Renewable Energy Grid Integration
headline: National Green Corridors Project Integrates 50 GW Offshore and Thar Solar into Interstate Grid
body: Power Grid Corporation operationalized interstate transmission corridors equipped with dynamic reactive power compensators (STATCOMs). Transmitting renewable power from desert solar parks to industrial load centers curtails renewable curtailment losses.
hindi: हरित ऊर्जा गलियारा परियोजना के माध्यम से 50 गीगावाट सौर और पवन ऊर्जा को राष्ट्रीय ग्रिड से जोड़कर स्वच्छ बिजली वितरण सुनिश्चित किया गया।

syllabus: GS-II: Electoral Transparency & Citizen Right to Know
headline: Supreme Court Mandates Transparency in Electoral Bonds Verdict: Landmark Disclosure Precedent
body: In a unanimous landmark verdict, the Supreme Court struck down the Electoral Bond Scheme as unconstitutional under Article 19(1)(a). The apex court mandated complete public disclosure of bond purchase and redemption records, elevating transparency in political financing.
hindi: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने चुनावी बॉन्ड योजना को असंवैधानिक घोषित करते हुए दानदाताओं और राजनीतिक दलों के विवरण को सार्वजनिक करने का ऐतिहासिक फैसला दिया।

syllabus: GS-III: Agricultural Marketing & Export Promotion
headline: National Turmeric Board and Spices Export Promotion Drive Farm Earnings
body: The Union Cabinet notified the operationalization of the National Turmeric Board headquartered in Telangana. Focusing on value-addition, organic certification, and curcumin extraction, the board targets two billion dollars in annual spice exports by 2030.
hindi: राष्ट्रीय हल्दी बोर्ड के गठन से किसानों को मूल्य संवर्धन, अनुसंधान और वैश्विक निर्यात बाजारों का सीधा लाभ मिलेगा।

syllabus: GS-III: Science and Technology & Innovation Ecosystem
headline: Deep Tech Startup Policy: Dedicated Fund-of-Funds to Nurture Advanced R&D
body: The Principal Scientific Adviser drafted the National Deep Tech Startup Policy to finance intellectual property-heavy ventures in robotics, photonics, and space technology. Longer gestation patent life cycles receive specialized venture equity and testing infrastructure.
hindi: राष्ट्रीय डीप टेक स्टार्टअप नीति के तहत रोबोटिक्स, फोटोनिक्स और अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान में लगे नवोन्मेषी उद्यमों को दीर्घकालिक वित्तीय सहायता दी जा रही है।

syllabus: GS-III: Infrastructure: Railways Safety and Modernization
headline: Kavach Automatic Train Protection System Deployed Across High-Density Rail Routes
body: Indian Railways accelerated the deployment of the indigenously developed Kavach 4.0 safety system along the Delhi-Mumbai and Delhi-Howrah passenger corridors. Utilizing radio frequency identification and automated cab signaling, the system prevents signal passing at danger and head-on collisions.
hindi: भारतीय रेलवे ने 'कवच 4.0' स्वचालित ट्रेन सुरक्षा प्रणाली को मुख्य रेल मार्गों पर तेजी से लागू किया, जिससे ट्रेन दुर्घटनाओं पर प्रभावी रोक लगेगी।

syllabus: GS-III: Conservation of Biodiversity & Global Ecosystem Pacts
headline: National Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan Aligns with Kunming-Montreal Targets
body: India updated its NBSAP to reflect the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework commitments. Key targets include conserving 30 percent of terrestrial and coastal ecosystems by 2030 (30x30) and halving pesticide run-off risks to protect pollinator populations.
hindi: भारत ने कुनमिंग-मॉन्ट्रियल समझौते के अनुरूप अपनी राष्ट्रीय जैव विविधता रणनीति को अद्यतन किया, जिसमें 30% भूमि और जल संरक्षण का लक्ष्य शामिल है।

syllabus: GS-II: Welfare of Persons with Disabilities & Inclusive Education
headline: Indian Sign Language (ISL) Standardized Curriculum Integrated into Digital Classrooms
body: The Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities released over 10,000 standardized ISL educational terms on the DIKSHA portal. Providing sign-language video translations across NCERT textbooks guarantees accessible and inclusive primary learning.
hindi: दिव्यांगजनों के समावेशी शिक्षण के लिए एनसीईआरटी पाठ्यपुस्तकों में भारतीय सांकेतिक भाषा (ISL) का मानकीकृत डिजिटल पाठ्यक्रम शामिल किया गया।

syllabus: GS-II: Bilateral Strategic Ties & Resource Security
headline: India-Australia Critical Minerals Partnership Fast-Tracks Lithium Supply Security
body: Under the Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement (ECTA), Khanij Bidesh India Ltd (KABIL) acquired exploratory rights in Western Australian lithium and cobalt salt blocks. Diversified maritime supply chains shield Indian EV manufacturers from market volatility.
hindi: भारत-ऑस्ट्रेलिया आर्थिक सहयोग समझौते के तहत भारतीय सार्वजनिक उपक्रमों ने ऑस्ट्रेलियाई लिथियम और कोबाल्ट खदानों में हिस्सेदारी हासिल की।

syllabus: GS-III: Nuclear Energy, Three-Stage Nuclear Power Programme
headline: Fast Breeder Reactor (PFBR) at Kalpakkam Reaches Core Loading Phase
body: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre commenced fuel loading of the 500 MWe Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor at Kalpakkam. Utilizing uranium-plutonium mixed oxide (MOX) fuel, the reactor breathes lifecycle fuel while transmuting thorium, realizing the second stage of India's nuclear vision.
hindi: कलपक्कम में 500 मेगावाट के प्रोटोटाइप फास्ट ब्रीडर रिएक्टर (PFBR) की कोर लोडिंग शुरू हुई, जो भारत के त्रि-स्तरीय परमाणु कार्यक्रम का महत्वपूर्ण चरण है।

syllabus: GS-I: Heritage & Architectural Conservation
headline: National Maritime Heritage Complex (NMHC) at Lothal Revives Ancient Maritime Glory
body: The Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways reviewed construction progress on the world's largest maritime heritage museum at the Harappan port city of Lothal. Reconstructing dockyards and ancient trade galleys honors India's 5,000-year seafaring heritage.
hindi: लोथल के ऐतिहासिक हड़प्पा बंदरगाह पर राष्ट्रीय समुद्री विरासत परिसर (NMHC) का निर्माण हो रहा है, जो भारत के प्राचीन समुद्री इतिहास को प्रदर्शित करेगा।

syllabus: GS-III: Blue Economy, Fisheries & Aquaculture Infrastructure
headline: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) Drives Seafood Exports to Record Highs
body: India's marine and brackish-water aquaculture exports crossed sixty thousand crore rupees, backed by PMMSY cold-chain infrastructure and disease-diagnostic centers. Establishing seaweed farming clusters along Tamil Nadu's coast creates alternative livelihoods for fisherwomen.
hindi: पीएम मत्स्य संपदा योजना के तहत कोल्ड-चेन अवसंरचना और रोग परीक्षण सुविधाओं से समुद्री खाद्य निर्यात रिकॉर्ड स्तर पर पहुंचा।

syllabus: GS-II & GS-III: Consumer Protection & Circular Economy
headline: Right to Repair Framework Expanded to Consumer Electronics and Farm Implements
body: The Department of Consumer Affairs mandated smartphone, laptop, and agricultural tractor manufacturers to share diagnostic schematics and authentic spare parts on the national portal, ending artificial planned obsolescence.
hindi: उपभोक्ता मामलों के विभाग ने स्मार्टफोन और ट्रैक्टर निर्माताओं के लिए 'राइट टू रिपेयर' पोर्टल पर स्पेयर पार्ट्स और रिपेयरिंग मैनुअल साझा करना अनिवार्य किया।

syllabus: GS-II: Civil Services Reforms & Capacity Building
headline: Mission Karmayogi Digital Learning Portal Crosses 50 Lakh Civil Service Enrollments
body: The iGOT Karmayogi digital platform operationalized competency-based micro-courses for central and state civil servants. Shifting governance from 'rule-based' to 'role-based' capacity delivery improves public grievance redressal at grassroots collectorates.
hindi: मिशन कर्मयोगी के तहत 50 लाख से अधिक सरकारी कर्मचारियों ने डिजिटल प्रशिक्षण प्राप्त किया, जिससे प्रशासनिक दक्षता और नागरिक सेवाओं में सुधार हुआ।

syllabus: GS-III: Biotechnology, Bio-Economy & Synthetic Biology
headline: National Bio-Foundry Network Launched to Accelerate Biomanufacturing and Enzyme Synthesis
body: The Department of Biotechnology inaugurated state-of-the-art bio-foundries to synthesize bio-plastics, microbial enzymes, and recombinant proteins. The BioE3 (Biotechnology for Economy, Environment and Employment) policy targets a 300 billion dollar bio-economy by 2030.
hindi: जैव प्रौद्योगिकी विभाग ने बायो-प्लास्टिक और एंजाइम निर्माण के लिए बायो-फाउंड्री नेटवर्क लॉन्च किया, जो हरित जैव-अर्थव्यवस्था को बढ़ावा देगा।

syllabus: GS-III: Renewable Energy in Agriculture & Water Conservation
headline: Solar-Powered Irrigation Pumps Under PM-KUSUM Replace 15 Lakh Diesel Pump Sets
body: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy reported substantial carbon emission abatements under PM-KUSUM. Decoupling agricultural irrigation from costly diesel generators while allowing farmers to sell surplus solar power to discoms establishes sustainable green agrarian revenue.
hindi: पीएम-कुसुम योजना के तहत 15 लाख डीजल पंपों को सौर ऊर्जा संचालित पंपों में बदला गया, जिससे किसानों की डीजल लागत बची और अतिरिक्त आय हुई।

syllabus: GS-II: Consumer Rights & Digital Marketplace Regulation
headline: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) Cracks Down on Dark Patterns in E-Commerce
body: The CCPA issued punitive notices to travel booking portals and quick-commerce apps for deploying manipulative 'dark patterns' including false urgency, drip pricing, and forced basket additions. The guidelines protect digital consumer autonomy under the Consumer Protection Act.
hindi: केंद्रीय उपभोक्ता संरक्षण प्राधिकरण ने ई-कॉमर्स प्लेटफॉर्म्स पर भ्रामक विज्ञापनों और 'डार्क पैटर्न्स' (छुपी लागत, झूठी तात्कालिकता) पर रोक लगाने के सख्त निर्देश दिए।

syllabus: GS-II: Elections & Constitutional Amendments
headline: One Nation One Election: High-Level Committee Submits Recommendations on Simultaneous Polls - Phase 5
body: The High-Level Committee on Simultaneous Elections headed by former President Ram Nath Kovind submitted its report recommending synchronized polls for Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies in the first phase, followed by local body elections within 100 days. The reform requires constitutional amendments to Article 83 and Article 172 to curtail repetitive election cycles.
hindi: एक राष्ट्र एक चुनाव पर उच्च स्तरीय समिति ने लोकसभा और विधानसभा चुनाव एक साथ कराने की सिफारिश की, जिससे प्रशासनिक व्यय और नीतिगत ठहराव में कमी आएगी।

syllabus: GS-II: Land Records Modernization & Rural Empowerment
headline: SVAMITVA Scheme Completes Drone Property Mapping in Three Lakh Villages - Phase 5
body: The Ministry of Panchayati Raj achieved drone-based property surveying across three lakh villages under the SVAMITVA scheme. Issuing digitized property cards provides legal ownership documentation to rural property holders, facilitating bank credit collateral and settling village demarcation litigation.
hindi: स्वामित्व (SVAMITVA) योजना के तहत ड्रोन द्वारा 3 लाख गांवों का मानचित्रण पूरा हुआ और संपत्ति कार्ड वितरित किए गए, जिससे ग्रामीणों को ऋण प्राप्त करना आसान हुआ।

syllabus: GS-II: Important International Institutions & Global Governance
headline: UN Security Council Reform: G4 Nations Press for Permanent Representation Expansion - Phase 5
body: Foreign ministers of the G4 nations (India, Brazil, Germany, Japan) reiterated urgent demands for text-based negotiations on UN Security Council expansion. Outlining the outdated post-1945 multilateral power structure, the alliance highlighted that underrepresentation of Africa, Latin America, and India erodes the Council's global legitimacy.
hindi: जी4 देशों (भारत, ब्राजील, जर्मनी, जापान) ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद में स्थायी सदस्यता के विस्तार और वास्तविक सुधारों के लिए त्वरित वार्ता की मांग की।

syllabus: GS-III: Financial Regulators & Environmental Sustainability
headline: Reserve Bank of India Issues Directives on Green Deposits and ESG Financing - Phase 5
body: The RBI mandated scheduled commercial banks to allocate green deposits strictly toward renewable energy, clean transportation, and energy-efficient building infrastructure under third-party verified taxonomies. The guidelines eliminate greenwashing risks in corporate lending portfolios.
hindi: आरबीआई ने बैंकों द्वारा जारी 'ग्रीन डिपॉजिट' के लिए कड़े नियम बनाए, ताकि धन का उपयोग केवल नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा और पर्यावरण अनुकूल परियोजनाओं में ही हो।

syllabus: GS-III: Insurance Sector & Social Security Architecture
headline: Bima Sugam Digital Platform: Revolutionizing Insurance Penetration Across Rural India - Phase 5
body: The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) launched 'Bima Sugam', an electronic marketplace integrating life, health, and general insurance products. Operating as a single-window portal with zero broker commissions, the platform targets 'Insurance for All by 2047'.
hindi: इरडा (IRDAI) ने 'बीमा सुगम' डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म शुरू किया, जहां नागरिक एक ही स्थान पर जीवन और स्वास्थ्य बीमा आसानी से खरीद और क्लेम कर सकेंगे।

syllabus: GS-III: Geospatial Data, Science and Technology Innovations
headline: National Geospatial Policy: Open Access Mapping Unlocks Multi-Billion Dollar Spatial Economy - Phase 5
body: The Department of Science and Technology liberalized high-resolution topographical and geospatial mapping datasets. Integrating precision satellite positioning with PM Gati Shakti infrastructure planning accelerates canal routing, telecom fiber laying, and disaster hazard vulnerability profiling.
hindi: राष्ट्रीय भू-स्थानिक नीति के तहत उच्च-रिज़ॉल्यूशन डेटा को सार्वजनिक किया गया, जिससे बुनियादी ढांचे की सटीक योजना और आपदा प्रबंधन में बड़ी मदद मिलेगी।

syllabus: GS-III: Environmental Governance & Quasi-Judicial Authorities
headline: National Green Tribunal Enforces Strict River Floodplain Zone Demarcation - Phase 5
body: The National Green Tribunal directed state irrigation departments to notify statutory 25-year and 100-year flood lines along major river basins including Yamuna, Hindon, and Narmada. Unlawful commercial encroachments in designated river active zones face mandatory demolition to restore natural river storage capacity.
hindi: एनजीटी ने नदियों के बाढ़ मैदानों (फ्लडप्लेन) के सीमांकन और अवैध निर्माणों को हटाने के सख्त निर्देश दिए, ताकि भविष्य में जलभराव की त्रासदियों को रोका जा सके।

syllabus: GS-II: International Trade & Bilateral Agreements
headline: Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) with UAE Boosts Non-Oil Bilateral Trade - Phase 5
body: Bilateral merchandise trade between India and the UAE surged past 85 billion dollars under the CEPA framework. Preferential tariff concessions on gems, jewelry, textiles, and engineering goods were accompanied by local currency settlement (LCS) mechanisms using INR and AED.
hindi: भारत-यूएई व्यापार समझौते (CEPA) के तहत गैर-तेल व्यापार में ऐतिहासिक वृद्धि हुई और स्थानीय मुद्राओं (रुपया-दिरहम) में व्यापार सुगम हुआ।

syllabus: GS-II: Public Health & Welfare of Vulnerable Populations
headline: National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission: Genetic Screening in Tribal Belts - Phase 5
body: The Ministry of Health screened over two crore tribal citizens across seventeen high-prevalence states under the National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission 2047. Distributing digital genetic status cards prior to marriage counseling reduces disease transmission among vulnerable tribal families.
hindi: राष्ट्रीय सिकल सेल एनीमिया उन्मूलन मिशन के तहत आदिवासी क्षेत्रों में बड़े पैमाने पर जांच की गई और आनुवंशिक स्वास्थ्य कार्ड प्रदान किए गए।

syllabus: GS-III: Manufacturing Sector & Value-Added Industrial Textiles
headline: National Technical Textiles Mission: Indigenous Production of High-Tech Geotextiles - Phase 5
body: The Ministry of Textiles approved capital subsidies for manufacturing specialized agro-textiles, med-tech implants, and geo-textiles for Himalayan road slope stabilization. Developing indigenous high-performance carbon fibers curtails import dependency for aerospace and defense construction.
hindi: राष्ट्रीय तकनीकी वस्त्र मिशन के तहत सड़कों और बुनियादी ढांचे के लिए विशेष जियो-टेक्सटाइल्स और मेडिकल वस्त्रों के स्वदेशी उत्पादन को बढ़ावा दिया जा रहा है।
